title: Inspect battery cycle count
notes: Read Cycle Count in the Battery Information section. This prints the power report, not just a number.
A Mac without a battery may have no battery section.

title: Inspect Spotlight metadata for a file
notes: Shows Spotlight attributes, not every possible filesystem or application-specific attribute.
Unindexed files or unavailable attributes may produce missing or null values.

title: Inspect assertions preventing sleep
notes: Shows current power assertions and their owners. It is a snapshot, not a complete diagnosis of every sleep problem.

title: Verify an app code signature

path.description: Explicit app bundle path; never inferred from request text.

output_scope: Signature integrity of one explicit app bundle, including nested code.
privileges: No sudo; read access to the supplied bundle.
notes: Checks signature integrity and designated requirements without launching the app.
Does not establish developer identity, notarization or Gatekeeper acceptance.

title: Assess local Gatekeeper policy for an app

path.description: Explicit app bundle path; never inferred from request text.

output_scope: Local execute-policy assessment for one explicit app bundle at check time.
privileges: No sudo; read access to the supplied bundle.
notes: Local policy acceptance is not a guarantee for another Mac, future revocation, offline launch or runtime safety.
Does not independently validate the code signature or a stapled ticket.

title: Validate an app stapled notarization ticket

path.description: Explicit app bundle path; never inferred from request text.

output_scope: Validate the stapled ticket for one explicit app bundle.
privileges: No sudo; read access to the supplied bundle.
notes: Requires Apple Command Line Tools at the documented path; validation may contact Apple ticket services.
An absent ticket does not prove the app was never notarized. Quiet exit 0 indicates successful validation.
Does not establish signature integrity or local Gatekeeper acceptance.

title: Filter stored unified logs by subsystem, PID, level and time

subsystem.description: Exact ASCII subsystem: 1–255 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens; starts with a letter or digit.

pid.description: Explicit positive process ID; not a process name.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+HHMM with explicit UTC offset.

end.description: Same timestamp format, strictly later than start.

output_scope: Stored unified-log events matching all five explicit filters; compact text only.
privileges: Normal user with access to the log store; lookup never requests sudo.
notes: All filters are required and combined with AND. Only exact error or default severity is supported.
Uses an explicit PID, not process-name matching. PIDs can be reused; confirm the intended process and interval.
Empty output does not prove that no event occurred: retention, redaction and store access limit visibility.
No live monitoring, archives, message filters, info/debug persistence or complete diagnostic coverage. Time-boundary inclusivity is unverified.
